title: Llama holding a heart
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='fur' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#f7e2b8'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#e6c890'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- neck -->
  <rect x='38' y='40' width='16' height='40' rx='7' fill='url(#fur)' stroke='#c9a96e' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='80' rx='24' ry='15' fill='url(#fur)' stroke='#c9a96e' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- legs -->
  <rect x='33' y='88' width='6' height='9' rx='3' fill='#d9b979'/>
  <rect x='44' y='89' width='6' height='9' rx='3' fill='#f0d9a8'/>
  <rect x='55' y='89' width='6' height='9' rx='3' fill='#d9b979'/>
  <rect x='65' y='88' width='6' height='9' rx='3' fill='#f0d9a8'/>

  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='46' cy='30' rx='14' ry='13' fill='url(#fur)' stroke='#c9a96e' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <ellipse cx='34' cy='20' rx='4' ry='8' fill='#f0d9a8' stroke='#c9a96e' stroke-width='1.5' transform='rotate(-15 34 20)'/>
  <ellipse cx='58' cy='20' rx='4' ry='8' fill='#f0d9a8' stroke='#c9a96e' stroke-width='1.5' transform='rotate(15 58 20)'/>
  <!-- inner ears -->
  <ellipse cx='34' cy='21' rx='2' ry='5' fill='#f0a8b8' transform='rotate(-15 34 21)'/>
  <ellipse cx='58' cy='21' rx='2' ry='5' fill='#f0a8b8' transform='rotate(15 58 21)'/>

  <!-- snout -->
  <ellipse cx='52' cy='36' rx='8' ry='6' fill='#f7e6c4'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx='55' cy='34' rx='2.2' ry='1.6' fill='#a8744a'/>
  <!-- mouth -->
  <path d='M51 39 Q53 41 55 39' stroke='#a8744a' stroke-width='1.2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='41' cy='27' r='2.6' fill='#4a3a2a'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='27' r='2.6' fill='#4a3a2a'/>
  <circle cx='41.9' cy='26.2' r='0.9' fill='#fff8e6'/>
  <circle cx='50.9' cy='26.2' r='0.9' fill='#fff8e6'/>

  <!-- heart held by hooves -->
  <g>
    <path d='M30 62 C26 56, 18 56, 18 62 C18 68, 30 74, 30 78 C30 74, 42 68, 42 62 C42 56, 34 56, 30 62 Z'
          fill='#ff4d6d' stroke='#ff8fa6' stroke-width='1.5'/>
    <path d='M24 60 Q25 57 28 58' stroke='#ffb3c2' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  </g>
  <!-- front hooves -->
  <ellipse cx='22' cy='72' rx='4' ry='5' fill='#d9b979' stroke='#c9a96e' stroke-width='1'/>
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='72' rx='4' ry='5' fill='#d9b979' stroke='#c9a96e' stroke-width='1'/>
</svg>
